## Description

Log contact attempts per task: channel (Call/WhatsApp/SMS), outcome (Spoke · rebooked, Spoke · declined, No answer · retry tomorrow, Wrong number, Message delivered (not a contact)), notes, time, by whom. Templates without clinical details; opt-in per channel shown.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Save outcome is disabled until channel and outcome are selected.
- [ ] **AC2.** "Message delivered" never moves a task to Patient contacted (test) — microcopy msg.delivered "Delivered — this does not complete the task".
- [ ] **AC3.** Contact history is shown on the task and patient record.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
